text: The GLRM observation model follows the Udell/LowRankModels separation: each feature owns a domain, embedding, natural-parameter slice, loss, and decoder; row/decoder regularizers are distinct factor-penalty types. ObservationPattern uses disjoint point-observed, missing, structurally inapplicable, and censored states. Positive weights cannot masquerade as missingness; censored cells fail closed until a censoring likelihood exists. Ordinal logits carry an ordered convex domain and categorical logits expose their common-shift gauge. MCAR/MAR/MNAR statements are provenance only.
